description: Binding emergency-operation and recovery policy for Memory OS rate limiting. The policy forbids unlimited or fail-open public traffic. It defines strict local fallback, route fail-closed and trusted-proxy disablement, but no production control plane or completed drill exists.

operationalModes.description: Configured policy and store behavior for the deployment.
Short-lived bounded local fallback for explicitly approved routes whose policy already declares fail_closed_emergency_local.
Reject the affected public route with bounded public error behavior while preserving health and internal operational access.
Permit traffic without enforceable limits or allow on store uncertainty.

proxyModes.requirement: ignore forwarded client address and derive only from direct peer
